edits.marker: ## Retained consequence can exceed current evaluative use
edits.addition:
## Consequences, access and relevant inquiry

The [inquiry-selection integration](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CONSEQUENCE-INQUIRY-SELECTION-INTEGRATION.md) first preserves what the tree already establishes. Acquired applicability already changes the next inquiry through actual failure; the completed calibration continuation now forms access to the persistent full-load effect and uses acquired mismatch to activate a fresh test. Another general inquiry selector is not the missing foundation.

The old relay's remaining limitation can now be stated exactly. At its actual exhausted endpoints, ordinary success and calibration failure have equal accessible histories but different load/waste outcomes. Every event in the unchanged law preserves the stock allocation; transfer cannot proceed, and the other events do not read that allocation. A general proof covers every finite request word and every finite feedback policy using the common view and identically initialized memory. The outcome remains physically present. The richer contact extension adds a relation through which it becomes acquired; it is outside the old-law limit. Earlier contact-zero correction of a false weak indication remains separately certified.

Relevance also has a precise conditional content. Once the prior full outcome at its used setting is acquired, both weak settings equally divide the remaining response-table family. Yet only a weak test at the used setting decides whether that application's weak response agrees with its full effect. An off-setting test leaves opposite answers possible. This justifies the installed priority for that local question, without inventing a scalar reward or claiming the priority learned its own origin. Test setting and contact-route index are different coordinates; a reliable route remains necessary.

The source-bound proofs and independent review preserve physical conditions, actual acquired records and the question's history. They establish neither global calibration nor the worth of spending remaining support on diagnosis after the packet is gone. The next foundation question concerns the justified scope of continuing activity and inquiry, using existing requirement-learning, renewal and concern results. Core and tree remain reciprocal articulations of that unfolding: a representation's omitted interaction, an actual access limit and an ethically unwarranted continuation require different corrections.
